facts.text: Little one, eat your fish and coconut. The sea will still be there after lunch, and so will I.
facts.why: Printed in quote marks as Gramma Tala's words, but it is not a line from the film. I could not open a quote page for this pass (the search tool was out of budget), so there is no quote source.
facts.fix: Little one, eat up. The ocean will keep, and so will I.

facts.text: Gramma Tala's recipe, eaten down by the shore.
facts.why: Nothing in the transcript or plot has Tala cooking or owning a recipe. She shows Moana the ships and the heart; the shore is where Moana goes down to the water.
facts.fix: Eaten down by the shore. Heihei wants a bite.
